verdict: UNMEASURED for the paths that matter most

measured.caveat: Query counts are a valid structural signal. Latencies here are NOT production SLOs.

results.error: probe used wrong method signature - NOT MEASURED

n_plus_1.assessment: The lexical heuristic produced false positives. Eager loading is effective on the one relationship-bearing path measured (2 queries). No N+1 change was justified.

not_measured: HTTP-level latency including middleware and serialisation
why: No measured regression justified an optimisation, and every plausible optimisation (index, cache, pagination, eager load) changes behaviour or the schema.
